title: Immediate Relief self-hosted edge deploy workflow
observed_behavior: docs/push-to-deploy-and-hiveci-runbook.md described an immediate self-hosted runner deploy workflow as an inline prototype.
The repository did not contain a deterministic helper for safely mutating the live edge docker-compose.yml.
intended_behavior: Pushes to master run the deploy workflow on a self-hosted edge-01 Docker runner with serialized deploy concurrency.
The workflow builds local backend and web images tagged github-<shortsha> from the pushed commit.
The workflow stages the release tree under /srv/data/bahia-controlplane/releases/github-<shortsha>.

The workflow backs up the live compose file before mutation, updates bahia/relay/web images and the release docs mount through a checked-in helper, applies the three services, and verifies backend, relay, and web health endpoints.
The durable Hive-CI artifact publishing path remains tracked by bahia-fj0z and is not implemented in this vertical slice.

excluded: Bahia artifact registration from Hive-CI results
